summary_1line: Sanjaya urges Yudhishthira to avoid war, praising virtue over wealth and warning that desire and violence will stain fame and nullify past righteousness.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sanjaya stands before Yudhishthira in a royal hall, raising a hand in solemn counsel while warriors and banners loom in the background.
The five Pandava brothers sit together in tense silence as Sanjaya warns them that even sovereignty is not worth the stain of sinful war.
